description: You are a QA engineer introducing test coverage standards at a fintech company. The transaction-service project at /home/ga/transaction-service currently has NO test coverage. Import the project into Eclipse. Your tasks are: (1) Add the JaCoCo Maven plugin to pom.xml configured to run during the 'test' phase and generate an HTML coverage report, with a minimum line coverage rule of 70%. (2) Write JUnit 5 tests using Mockito mocks for TransactionRepository and AccountRepository — you must test TransactionService (deposit, withdrawal, transfer, reversal, error cases), FeeCalculator (all account types and transaction types), and TransactionValidator (valid and invalid inputs). (3) Run 'mvn clean test' to generate the JaCoCo coverage report. The coverage report must exist at target/site/jacoco/index.html and line coverage must reach at least 70% across the service classes.
